title: Borderland Society knew of UFO crashes before the government

tellings.quote: >> you know the Borderlands Society, this sort of occult research group like in the ' 40s. They were aware of certain UFO crashes before the government was and there's documentation of that.
And he he has uncovered like a couple of UFO either crashes or appearances where the Borderlands Society knew about these UFO appearances before the military did before the army before the air force.
tellings.difference: Credits Richard Geldreich with uncovering it, includes appearances as well as crashes, and gives no decade.
tellings.link_reason: Both claim the Borderland(s) Society knew of UFO crashes or appearances before the military or government did.

as_told.title: BSRA knew of crashes before intelligence agencies

plain: An occult research group of the 1940s called the Borderland Society is said to have known about certain UFO crashes before the US government did, and Michels says there is documentation of it. He brings this up on several episodes, sometimes crediting a researcher named Richard Geldreich with uncovering it. His versions differ: in one the group learned of crashes and sightings before the Army and the Air Force, in another it learned through remote viewing (trying to see distant places with the mind) in the 1940s and 50s, and in another it sometimes knew of crashes before they happened, which, if true, would mean a private circle had better sources than the military.
